title: Considering the only Dreamgirls production I’ve experienced live was ...
transcript: thank goodness thank goodness that one we're getting a dreamgirls revival this is the first ever revival on Broadway which is ridiculous frankly also thank goodness this is coming Fall 26 because this season is already stacked for revivals and I would not want dreamgirls competing against ragtime and chess and Rocky Horror and Jellicle Ball and we don't know much about this DreamGirls revival yet except that it is going to be both choreographed and directed by Camille a brown who choreographed Gypsy and I would have loved to see what she did with that show so I cannot wait to see what she does with dreamGirls I also have never seen a stage production of Dreamgirls despite this being one of my favourite movie musicals in existence like I think that the film is brilliant so I I cannot wait to see this and I cannot wait to see what Camille a Brown does with it and of course I cannot wait to see this cast now they are doing an open casting call for this which as we know with open casting calls sometimes they still have people in mind or people that have been doing workshops or you know going along on this journey with them uh and the casting calls are for replacements or standbys or ensemble members but I do hope that we see some fresh faces in this revival uh but I cannot wait to see who is in this cast I cannot wait to see the creative team and I just I can't wait to get a dream girls revival and I hope I hope that this one actually happens I'm a little I'm a little scarred by the 2016 announcement but I really hope this one happens and especially with Camille a Brown directing it I think this is this is high on my list of revivals I cannot wait to see
